questions.question_text: How many loops are there in the given circuit?
questions.answer: A bridge circuit with its source has 6 branches and 4 nodes, so it has $6-4+1=3$ independent loops.

questions.question_text:
Consider the following pairs
Series circuit: Voltage division rule
Parallel circuit: Current division rule
Open circuit: Resistance is zero
Short circuit: Resistance is maximum
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.answer: Only the first two pairs are correct; open circuit has infinite resistance and short circuit has zero, so 2 are correct.

questions.question_text:
Consider the following Statements
1. In a parallel circuit, the current is the same through all the elements
2. Current will not flow in an open circuit
3. Ohm's law does not apply to parallel circuits
4. In a series circuit, voltage is the same across all the resistors
How many statements given above are correct?
questions.answer: Only statement 2 is true: parallel elements share voltage, series elements share current, and Ohm's law applies everywhere.

questions.question_text: The expression for RMS voltage in half wave rectifier is
questions.answer: For a half-wave rectifier $V_{rms}=V_m/2$.

questions.question_text: What does the equivalent circuit of the diode shown represent?
questions.answer: A reverse-biased diode acts as an open switch.

questions.question_text: MOSFET is a type of transistor that uses an _______ to control
questions.answer: A MOSFET's gate electric field controls the channel conductivity.

questions.question_text: SCR terminals are
questions.answer: An SCR has anode, cathode and gate.

questions.question_text: _______ impuritie is tri-valent.
questions.answer: Boron (group III) is trivalent; antimony, arsenic and phosphorus are pentavalent.

questions.question_text: _______ of the DC generator is in the form of a laminated slotted drum.
questions.answer: The armature is the laminated slotted drum that carries the windings.

questions.question_text: _______ is a polyphase synchronous motor with a permanent magnet rotor.
questions.answer: A BLDC motor is a polyphase synchronous machine with a permanent-magnet rotor.

questions.question_text: _______ is a combination of an electric motor, a transmission, and a control system
questions.answer: An electric drive = motor + transmission + control system.

questions.question_text: _______ is a motor that can rotate with great precision
questions.answer: A servomotor gives precise position and speed control using feedback.

questions.question_text: _______ ensures that the moving system takes just the required time to reach its final deflected position
questions.answer: Damping torque stops oscillation so the pointer settles quickly at its final reading.

questions.question_text: _______ is a device which converts the energy from one form to another form
questions.answer: A transducer converts energy from one form to another.

questions.question_text: Which device works on the simple principle of change in resistance due to a change in temperature?
questions.answer: A thermistor's resistance changes with temperature.

questions.question_text: _______ is an electronically modulated optical device
questions.answer: An LCD modulates light electronically using liquid crystals.

questions.question_text: _______ are attached to the poles or towers and are used to support the conductors
questions.answer: Cross arms are fixed to poles or towers to support insulators and conductors.

questions.question_text: _______ transmission system is more economical when the distance of transmission is more than 600 km.
questions.answer: Beyond about 600 km, HVDC is cheaper because of lower line cost and losses.

questions.question_text: _______ is an equipment which can open or close a circuit under normal as well as fault conditions.
questions.answer: A circuit breaker can make and break a circuit under normal and fault conditions; an isolator works only off-load.

questions.question_text: A large number of solar cells are interconnected to form _______
questions.answer: Many cells joined in series/parallel make a solar module (panel).
